Sometimes you just have to burn usage for a good cause. Last night I went down a rabbit hole and built a site, FB, and YouTube for my local community.

It aggregates elected official data from city, county, and school boards.

It scrapes videos from oddball hosts like Vimeo and Google Drive, which make public information less accessible(I can see it in the view count), and reposts them to YouTube(well titled and chaptered). Some use YouTube and we just link to them. 

It then transcribed them all, verified meeting minutes, and saved available documents. It cross references everything and notes any in confirmed items. 

This creates a site where you can search any word or topic, easily access links and budgets, and view any elected official’s voting record (Yes/No/Abstain, etc.). Filter by self-sorted topics or unanimous/split votes, then see headlines, results, and clickable links to videos that start right where the content lives. 

Data goes back to the longest-tenured person’s start date. These are boring meetings that last hours with lots of wasted filler. People are too busy to know what’s happening. It recaps meetings weekly, pulls key clips, and posts them to FB and YouTube. Free email signup for the newsletter. Every elected person has their start date and next election date visible. Non-partisan, just data to consume.

I DO NOT CODE
I DO NOT HAVE THE TIME

I DO HAVE A @bot
I DO WANT TO BE INFORMED

DM me if you want to set this up for your community. I don’t know if a bot template would work, but I’m willing to chat and share. 

AI can be a power for good if you put in a little work and a few dollars. Thanks @grok  and @spacexai !

Well that's why i'm building the habit to keep track of my intake and calorie burn.  I skipped the fitness apps and set up grok bot with a spreadsheet.  I just message it what I ate and what my activity is and it figures it out.  Dont have to scroll through lists of food or look things up to enter them ever.  

The calories in vs out equation does not change.  Well, aside from the 200 calories extra you get if you're taking reta.  You just have to keep paying attention.  If you never were from the start and just ate when you were hungry, you would lose way too fast on these drugs and feel super shitty all of the time.  Then when you come off of them, the hunger comes back and you overeat because you never started tracking your intake and don't know what's an appropriate amount to eat.   

It's just a math problem and most people who take these drugs never keep track of anything.   So for them it all comes right back
